  "description": "At ASA Security, we are a Nigerian company registered for the provision of internationally recognized advanced security technology services. We have been delivering special protection and consulting expertise in the security industry for over thirty (30) years.

We are proud of our position as one of the leading provider of security knowledge and capabilities for the industrial, private and government sectors in the security industry and we understand that our success is due to the quality of our staff.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: CCTV &amp; Access Control Maintenance Supervisor

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	The CCTV &amp; Access Control Maintenance Technician is responsible for carrying out the installation, preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, and testing of CCTV surveillance systems, access control systems, boom barriers, intrusion alarm systems, intercom systems, and other electronic security systems.
	The technician ensures all assigned maintenance tasks are completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with company standards and client requirements.


Key Responsibilities


	Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on CCTV, access control, boom barrier, intercom, intrusion alarm, and other electronic security systems.
	Install, test, commission, and troubleshoot CCTV cameras, NVRs/DVRs, access controllers, biometric devices, card readers, electric locks, magnetic locks, exit buttons, boom barriers, and related equipment.
	Diagnose and repair hardware, software, power supply, and network-related faults.
	Install and terminate data cables, power cables, fiber optic cables, and other structured cabling systems.
	Configure IP cameras, NVRs/DVRs, network switches, access control controllers, and related devices.
	Perform routine system inspections and preventive maintenance according to the maintenance schedule.
	Replace defective equipment and components as directed by the supervisor.
	Maintain proper cable management, equipment labeling, and housekeeping at work sites.
	Test systems after maintenance or repairs to ensure proper operation before handing them over to the client.
	Complete service reports, maintenance checklists, and job completion documentation accurately.
	Report equipment defects, recurring faults, and customer concerns to the Maintenance Supervisor.
	Ensure all assigned tools, test equipment, and company assets are properly maintained and accounted for.
	Follow company safety procedures and always use the required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
	Respond promptly to emergency service calls and breakdown maintenance when required.
	Maintain good working relationships with clients and represent the company professionally at all times.


Required Qualifications


	Diploma, OND, HND, or a Technical Certificate in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
	Professional training or certification in CCTV, networking, or access control systems is an added advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum of 3&ndash;5 years of experience in CCTV and access control installation and maintenance.
	Experience working with IP CCTV systems, access control systems, boom barriers, and electronic security systems.
	Experience with structured cabling and basic networking.


Working Conditions:


	12-hour work shifts as scheduled.
	Availability for emergency call-outs, overtime, and after-hours support when required.
	Ability to work at heights and in industrial, commercial, and outdoor environments.
	Ability to lift and carry tools and equipment safely.
	A valid driver&#39;s license is an added advantage (or mandatory if the role includes driving company vehicles).


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: career@foresightis.com using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

  "description": "KannyVic Enterprise Consult - Our client, a reputable and growing organization, is recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Legal Secretary

Job Locations: Abuja (FCT) and Delta
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	A reputable and growing organization is seeking to recruit a competent, discreet, and highly organized Legal Secretary to provide professional secretarial, administrative, and documentation support to its legal and management functions.
	The ideal candidate must be detail-oriented, trustworthy, professional, and highly confidential, with the ability to manage legal documents, correspondence, contracts, files, meetings, and other administrative matters efficiently.
	The Legal Secretary will provide comprehensive secretarial and administrative support in the preparation, organization, filing, and management of legal documents and correspondence.
	The successful candidate will assist with maintaining legal files, preparing contracts and agreements, scheduling meetings, taking minutes, managing correspondence, and liaising with external lawyers, consultants, government agencies, and other relevant parties as required.
	The role requires excellent organizational skills, strong written and verbal communication, good knowledge of office procedures, and the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.





Responsibilities
The successful candidate will be responsible for:


	Preparing, typing, formatting, proofreading, and filing legal documents, letters, agreements, contracts, reports, minutes, and official correspondence.
	Maintaining and organizing legal files, contracts, agreements, company documents, and confidential records.
	Assisting with the preparation and review of routine legal correspondence and documentation.
	Maintaining an effective filing and document retrieval system for legal and corporate records.
	Liaising with external lawyers, legal consultants, government agencies, regulatory bodies, and other official organizations when required.
	Scheduling meetings, appointments, hearings, and other legal or management engagements.
	Preparing meeting agendas, taking minutes, and circulating relevant documents where required.
	Managing incoming and outgoing legal correspondence and ensuring timely follow-up on outstanding matters.
	Maintaining a register of contracts, agreements, legal documents, and important deadlines.
	Assisting in tracking contract renewal dates, statutory deadlines, court dates, and other important legal timelines.
	Conducting basic legal research and gathering information as directed by the supervising lawyer or management.
	Ensuring that legal and corporate documents are properly stored, updated, and readily accessible.
	Handling confidential information with the highest level of discretion and professionalism.
	Providing general administrative and secretarial support to the legal function and management.
	Performing other duties as may reasonably be assigned.


Requirements
Applicants must possess:


	A minimum of Bachelor&#39;s Degree, or equivalent qualification in Law.
	Prior experience as a Legal Secretary, Legal Assistant or Office Secretary.
	Good knowledge of legal documentation, contracts, agreements, correspondence, and filing systems.
	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	Strong computer skills, particularly Microsoft Word, Excel, email management, and document formatting.
	Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and handle sensitive legal and company information.
	Strong organizational, time management, and record-keeping skills.
	Excellent typing, proofreading, and document preparation skills.
	Ability to multitask, prioritize assignments, and work with minimal supervision.
	Professional appearance, good interpersonal skills, and a high level of integrity.
	Knowledge of basic Nigerian legal and regulatory procedures will be an added advantage.
	Legal secretarial and administrative skills

	Excellent typing and proofreading skills
	Filing and records management
	Strong written and verbal communication
	Confidentiality and discretion
	Microsoft Office proficiency
	Attention to detail
	Time management and organization
	Professional correspondence
	Ability to multitask and prioritize
	Strong interpersonal skills
	Problem-solving and follow-up skills.


Salary


	Very competitive inline with industry standard.
